items.title: Rahul Gandhi invites INDIA bloc MPs, civil society and student groups for high tea Tuesday 4 PM; joint press conference before it
items.summary: Rahul Gandhi has invited INDIA bloc MPs, civil society members and student organisations for high tea at his residence (5 Sunehri Bagh Road, New Delhi) at 4:00 PM IST Tuesday, Oct 13. A joint press conference of INDIA leaders will be held Tuesday afternoon before the tea, to discuss the joint protest strategy against 'vote chori' and the next phase of action against the EC, including pressing for CEC Gyanesh Kumar's resignation. Congress leader Abhishek Manu Singhvi is expected to address the press conference. Separately, CPIM's MA Baby says Congress told allies there will be NO large-scale demonstration in Delhi on Tuesday after the successful march and petition filing; TMC's Derek O'Brien notes festival-season plans, while Youth Congress and Seva Dal may hold protests in multiple states.
